lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the gill slits, organized into roughly four visible horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersecting with the spot centroids to form a structural grid across the mid-flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge located on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition from high-intensity dorsal to low-intensity ventral pixels.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin contains a high-density cluster of high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller in diameter than those on the lateral flank.
